entities.summary: Andromeda Botanic Gardens is an organic 8-acre (3.2 ha) botanical garden and a historic cultural attraction in the village of Bathsheba, Saint Joseph in Barbados. It is an authentic garden created by multiple award-winning horticulturalist Iris Bannochie, a female, Barbadian, self-taught scientist. It is unique, having been created from the 1950s as both a private botanical garden and a pleasure garden by an individual. Named from the Greek mythological figure of Andromeda it started as a private plant collection around Ms Bannochie's home, who was also the leading expert on horticulture on the island.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Andromeda Botanic Gardens is a unique cultural attraction that showcases the work of self-taught scientist Iris Bannochie, who created an authentic organic garden in Barbados from the 1950s. Her legacy has contributed to the preservation of horticulture expertise on the island.
